blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ensemble weather forecasts can look reliable in global averages while hiding too little spread in some cases and too much in others. These errors vary across variables, spatial scales, lead times, and weather states. Adapting randomness during forecasting can correct these errors, but training fixes stochastic behavior beforehand and output calibration acts afterward. Inference guidance also acts during forecasting, but typically scores ensemble members separately rather than the ensemble as a whole. Reliability feedback arrives at the end, and tracing it backward through many chaotic forecast steps is expensive and unstable. We therefore introduce Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law (DIAL), which controls a frozen model's native stochasticity. DIAL learns from past forecasts to predict whether each variable and scale needs more or less spread. As a forecast develops, it estimates how possible noise changes will affect later forecast accuracy and reliability. It combines these predictions to make small noise updates at each step. This loop avoids retraining the weather model and full backpropagation through the forecast. We evaluate DIAL on FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) using later ERA5 years unseen during training. DIAL provides better scale-resolved reliability than learned postprocessing and reward-based control baselines. Relative to the unmodified Native FCN3 reference, DIAL achieves an 8.27% improvement in the primary multiscale continuous ranked probability score (CRPS).
blocks.zh: 汇总的天气预报在全球平均数中可以看起来可靠,而在某些情况中隐藏的传播太少,在另一些情况中则太少。 这些错误因变量、空间尺度、准备时间和天气状况而异。 在预报中适应随机性可以纠正这些错误,但训练事先纠正了有花样的行为,然后输出校正行为. 推论指导在预测期间也起作用,但一般会分别评分综艺成员而不是综艺. 可靠性反馈到达了终点,通过许多混乱的预测步骤来追溯到后方是昂贵和不稳定的. 因此,我们引入了动态和知情调整土著施托克斯特克法(DIAL),它控制了被冻结的模型的土著作风. DIAL从过去的预测中吸取了教训来预测每个变量和尺度是否需要多或少的分布. 随着预测的发展,它估计可能发生的噪声变化将如何影响以后的预测准确性和可靠性. 它结合了这些预测,在每个步骤上进行小噪声更新. 这个循环避免了天气模型的再培训,并通过预报完全回传. 我们在FourCastNet 3(FCN3)上利用培训期间所未见的晚年ERA5评价DIAL。 DIAL提供比所学的后处理和基于奖励的控制基线更好的规模解决方案可靠性. 相对于未经修改的原生FCN3参考,DIAL在初级多级连续分级概率分数(CRPS)上取得了8.27%的改进.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ensemble weather forecasts represent atmospheric uncertainty by generating multiple plausible futures rather than a single deterministic forecast ( Price et al. 2025 ; Lang et al. 2026 ) . An ensemble is reliable when its spread matches the error of its ensemble mean forecast across many cases ( Gneiting, Balabdaoui, and Raftery 2007 ; Dirkson and Buehner 2026 ) . The spread-to-skill ratio (SSR) quantifies this relationship: low values indicate an overconfident ensemble, whereas high values indicate an underconfident ensemble ( Dirkson and Buehner 2026 ) . Yet Figure 1 shows that global averages can hide opposing reliability gaps across variables, spatial scales, forecast lead times, and weather states ( Rodwell et al. 2018 ; Jung and Leutbecher 2008 ) .
blocks.zh: 综合天气预报通过产生多种可能的未来而不是单一的确定性预报来表示大气中的不确定性(Price等人,2025;Lang等人,2026)。 一个综艺节目的传播与许多情况下的综艺节目平均预测(Gneiting、Balabdaoui和Rafrey 2007;Dirkson和Buehner 2026)的误差相符,是可靠的。 分布-技能比(SSR)将这种关系量化:低值表示过度自信的组合,而高值表示信心不足的组合(Dirkson and Buehner 2026). 然而图1显示,全球平均值可以隐藏各种变量、空间尺度、预测周转时间和天气状态之间的相反可靠性差距(Rodwell等人,2018年;Jung和Leutbecher,2008年)。

blocks.en: Reliability diagnostics reveal gaps in FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) ( Bonev et al. 2025 ) , NeuralGCM ( Kochkov et al. 2024 ) , and ArchesWeatherGen (AWG) ( Couairon et al. 2024 ) . The patterns differ across systems, and FCN3 exhibits reliability gaps in both directions within a single model. Figure 1 (a) shows that FCN3 is overconfident at large scales but underconfident at the smallest scales. For several wind variables, the gap also changes direction with lead time. Together, these patterns require reliability control to work in both directions, making FCN3 a demanding test case.

blocks.en:
Achieving this control requires deciding when and where to intervene in the forecasting process.
Existing methods act at three stages, and each stage has a different limitation.
Training methods learn stochastic behavior together with the forecast model, but this behavior is usually fixed after deployment and cannot adapt to the current forecast state ( Price et al. 2025 ; Lang et al. 2026 ; Bonev et al. 2025 ) .
Output calibration corrects completed forecasts, but cannot change how randomness enters the model or develops through weather dynamics ( Chen et al. 2024 ; Ben Bouallègue et al. 2024 ) .
Inference guidance steers a pretrained generator during sampling without retraining it ( Dhariwal and Nichol 2021 ; Ren et al. 2026 ) .
Such guidance usually scores samples separately rather than learning how possible updates affect joint ensemble reliability.
These limitations motivate closed-loop control that adjusts the native noise of a frozen model as the forecast evolves and corrects signed reliability gaps.
blocks.zh:
实现这种控制需要决定何时何地干预预测过程。
现有方法在三个阶段运作,每个阶段都有不同的限制.
训练方法与预测模型一起学习有花样的行为,但这种行为通常在部署后被固定,无法适应目前的预测状态(Price等. 2025; Lang等2026; Bonev等2025).
输出校正可以校正已完成的预测,但不能改变随机性如何进入模型或通过天气动态发展(Chen等. 2024; Ben Bouallègue等 2024 (中文(简体) ).
推论指导在取样时引导一个经过预先训练的发电机,而不对其进行再培训(Dhariwal和Nichol 2021;Ren等人 2026)。
这种指导通常对样本进行单独评分,而不是学习可能的更新如何影响联合综艺的可靠性.
这些限制刺激了闭路控制,随着预测的演化,调节了被冻结模型的原生噪声并纠正了所签名的可靠性差距.

blocks.en:
Implementing this control in FCN3 requires estimating how each possible change to its native noise affects future skill and reliability.
FCN3 injects this noise at every forecast step, so control decisions occur every six hours ( Bonev et al. 2025 ) .
Reliability feedback arrives much later.
It can be computed only after the ensemble forecast is complete and the verifying weather data are available.
Full backpropagation through every forecast step and ensemble member would be too expensive.
Chaotic atmospheric dynamics can also make long-range gradients explode or vanish before they reach early control decisions ( Mikhaeil, Monfared, and Durstewitz 2022 ) .
Our 28-step reliability objective is much longer than FCN3’s final 8-step training stage, worsening both problems ( Bonev et al. 2025 ) .
Reliable long-horizon control therefore needs a way to assign delayed feedback without backpropagating through the complete forecast.
blocks.zh:
在FCN3中实施这一控制需要估计其原生噪音的每一种可能变化如何影响未来的技能和可靠性。
FCN3在每一个预报步骤都注入了这种噪声,因此控制决定每6小时发生一次(Bonev等人,2025年).
可靠性反馈的到来要晚得多。
只有在综艺预测完成并有核实的天气数据后才能计算。
通过每个预告步骤和综艺成员进行完全回升将过于昂贵.
Chaotic大气动力学还可以使长距离梯度在达成早期控制决定之前爆炸或消失(Mikhaeil、Monfared和Durstewitz 2022 ).
我们的28步可靠性目标比FCN3最后的8步训练阶段要长得多,加剧了这两个问题(Bonev等2025年)。
因此,可靠的长视距控制需要一种方法来分配延迟的反馈,而无需通过完整的预测进行反向传播。

blocks.en:
Recent image generation methods tune sampling with reinforcement learning or stochastic optimal control without backpropagating the final reward through the full process ( Black et al. 2024 ; Fan et al. 2023 ; Domingo-Enrich et al. 2025 ) .
Yet their objectives do not transfer directly to ensemble weather reliability.
First, image methods score outputs separately, but reliability is measured over the ensemble.
Second, one reward summarizes image quality, but reliability gaps must remain signed and separate by variable, spatial scale, and lead time.
Combining these gaps can let too little spread cancel too much spread elsewhere.
Third, image objectives usually favor one direction, but forecast spread can be above or below its target.
These differences require an ensemble reliability constraint.
A weather controller must therefore handle delayed feedback and increase or decrease spread separately for each variable and spatial scale.
blocks.zh:
近期的图像生成方法将采样与强化学习相调和,或者有花样的优化控制,而不通过全过程背传出最终的奖励(Black等. 2024; Fan等2023; Domingo-Enrich等2025).
然而,它们的目标并没有直接转移到天气的可靠性上。
第一,图像方法对输出进行分分,但可靠性通过综艺衡量.
第二,一项奖励总结了图像质量,但可靠性差距必须保持签名并按可变、空间尺度和准备时间分开。
把这些差距结合起来,可以让太小的传播消除了其他地方的过多传播。
第三,图像目标通常倾向于一个方向,但预测的传播可以高于或低于其目标.
这些差异要求具有共同的可靠性限制。
因此,气象控制员必须分别处理每个可变和空间尺度的延迟反馈并增加或减少分布。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 summarizes DIAL’s learning and control loop.
DIAL treats reliability repair as control of the native noise in a frozen weather model.
It uses signed ensemble constraints to state where spread should increase or decrease without assuming that the future weather distribution is known.
A KL budget limits how far the controlled distribution can move from the model’s native distribution.
Together with forecast loss, these constraints define an ideal Gibbs tilt that gives more weight to skillful and reliable forecast paths ( Donsker and Varadhan 1975 ) .
To handle delayed feedback without complete backpropagation, DIAL approximates this tilt through a closed loop.
The Estimator predicts reliability needs, while the Pilot tracks the evolving forecast.
The Q-Critic estimates how possible noise changes affect future skill and reliability.
The Controller then uses the Actuator’s variable- and scale-matched noise bases to make allowed updates within the remaining KL budget.
Our contributions are as follows.

图2总结了DIAL的学习和控制循环。
DIAL在冷冻天气模型中将可靠性修复视为对本土噪音的控制.
它使用签名的综艺约束来说明传播范围应该增加或减少哪些地方,而不假定未来的天气分布是已知的.
KL 预算会限制控制下的分配从模型的本地分配到多远。
加上预测的损失,这些制约因素界定了一个理想 Gibbs 倾斜让技巧和可靠的预测路径更加重要(Donsker和Varadhan,1975年)。
为了处理延迟反馈而不完全反向传播,DIAL通过闭环来取近于这种倾斜.
估算器预测可靠性需求,而Pilot跟踪不断变化的预测.
Q-批评者估计出可能发生的噪音变化会如何影响未来的技能和可靠性.
主计长然后利用精算师的可变和相规模相适应的噪声基础,在剩余的KL预算范围内进行允许的更新.
我们的贡献如下。

blocks.en:
• We formulate ensemble reliability repair as stochastic optimal control of a frozen model’s native noise under signed ensemble and KL constraints. • We propose DIAL, a closed loop that approximates the ideal path law without backpropagation through the full forecast.
The Estimator and Pilot track reliability needs and forecast evolution, while the Q-Critic and Controller guide variable- and scale-matched Actuator updates. • We evaluate DIAL on later ERA5 years against learned postprocessing and reward-based control.
Relative to the unmodified Native FCN3 reference, DIAL achieves an 8.27% improvement in the primary multiscale CRPS.
It also reduces reliability errors in both directions.

blocks.en:
This ideal law is not directly executable.
Its normalizer integrates over all future joint ensemble forecasts, and its future cost is unknown at decision time.
It may also require noise changes that the Actuator cannot realize.
DIAL therefore avoids the global normalizer and estimates the future cost from forecast-visible state.
At inference, it converts this estimate into a legal local update of the native noise without online truth.

这种理想的法律不能直接被执行.
它的常态化器融合了未来所有联合综艺预测,其未来成本在决策时未知.
这也可能需要改变噪声,而精算师是无法意识到的.
因此,DIAL避免了全球正常化,从预测可见状态估算出未来成本.
推论中,它将这个估计转换成没有网络真相的本土噪声在当地的法律更新.

blocks.en: Learning and Closed-Loop Inference
blocks.zh: 学习和闭环推论

blocks.en: DIAL learns only the two predictions required by the local solver: reliability demand from the Estimator and action-conditioned future cost from the Q-Critic. Native weather ensembles paired with verifying analyses provide the Estimator’s signed reliability labels. Normalization and low-rank bases are fitted only on the training split, and the Q-Critic receives out-of-fold Estimator predictions rather than demand estimates fitted to the same forecast cases. To train the Q-Critic, each pair starts from the same weather state and matched random innovations: one branch keeps the native noise settings, whereas the other executes an exploratory adjustment. The remaining-forecast score and moment contributions supervise the two heads. Differences between the paired branches isolate the action effect and check whether the learned action gradient points toward lower cost. After each pooled training batch, DIAL increases the reliability multiplier η \eta when the pooled reliability constraint is violated and increases the fidelity multiplier λ KL \lambda_{\rm KL} when the Path-KL budget is exceeded. The signed moment weights ξ \xi are updated from the pooled reliability residual rather than from individual forecast cases. After validation, DIAL freezes the selected checkpoint, dual variables, action bounds, and budget rules; all training-fitted normalizers and low-rank bases also remain fixed.
blocks.zh: DIAL只学习了本地解析器所需的两种预测:估计器的可靠性要求和Q-批评器的有行动条件的未来成本. 原生天气组合与核实分析配对,提供了估算器签名的可靠性标签。 规范化和低级别基地只根据培训情况进行,而Q-批评者得到的预测值超出估计值,而不是同一预测情况的需求估计值。 为了训练Q-批评,每对都从同一个天气状态开始,并匹配随机创新:一个分支保留了本土噪声设置,而另一个则执行探索调整. 剩下的预估分数和瞬间贡献都监督着两个头. 配对分支之间的差异隔离了动作效应并检查所学动作梯度是否指向更低的成本. 每批集合培训结束后,DIAL在集合可靠性约束被违反时会增加可靠性乘数 \\eta,在超过路径-KL预算时会增加忠诚乘数 {KL\lambda\rm KL}. 所签名的分量 \\xx 是从集合的可靠性剩余部分更新的,而不是从单个预测案例更新的。 经过验证,DIAL冻结了选定的检查站、双重变量、行动界限和预算规则;所有训练有素的正常化者和低级别基地也保持不变。

blocks.en: At inference, all learned components and control rules are frozen, and no verifying weather is available. The Estimator runs once from the pre-forecast history. At each forecast step, the Controller uses the lead-masked demand, live Pilot state, recurrent memory, and remaining KL ledger to compute the next feasible action, as summarized in Algorithm 1 .

blocks.en: Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate DIAL on frozen FCN3 forecasts initialized and verified with ERA5. DIAL applies native-noise control across all FCN3 variables throughout each rollout. We evaluate geopotential, temperature, and both wind components at 500 and 850 hPa, and include all eight fields in every aggregate. Scores cover eight spectral bands and 28 six-hour leads through 168 h. Training uses 240 initializations from 2017–2020, and validation uses 60 from 2021. The sealed test set contains 60 initializations from 2022, each with 30 ensemble members. We freeze all learned components, metric choices, action bounds, budgets, and statistical rules before test evaluation. Checkpoint, initialization sampling, preprocessing, and regridding details appear in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 我们对冻结的FCN3预报进行DIAL评估,并初始化,与ERA5核实. DIAL在每次推出时对所有FCN3变量实施本土噪声控制. 我们以500和850 hPa的速度评估地质潜力、温度和风能成分,并将所有8个字段纳入每个集合。 分数覆盖了8个光谱波段和28个6小时的通向168小时. 培训使用从2017-2020年开始的240个初始化,2021年开始的验证使用60个. 被封装的测试集包含从2022年开始的60个初始化,每个集有30个综艺成员. 在测试评价之前,我们冻结所有学到的知识、衡量标准的选择、行动范围、预算和统计规则。 检查点、初始化取样、预处理和重新网格细节见补编。

blocks.en: We compare seven ensemble methods with equal member weights. Native FCN3 is the unmodified reference. Three baselines act after the ensemble forecast is generated. Cond-SP uses forecast-visible state and estimated reliability demand to correct spread by variable, band, and lead while preserving the ensemble mean. PoET is retrained on Native FCN3 ensembles and retains its member-set processing and ensemble size ( Ben Bouallègue et al. 2024 ) . Generative multivariate postprocessing is adapted to sample complete forecast paths ( Chen et al. 2024 ) . DIAL is compared with two generation-time controllers. DRaFT-K-style and KL-PG share DIAL’s forecast-visible state, native-noise actions, legal set, objective, and training budget. All three use the same ex-ante Path-KL budget, chosen on validation. DRaFT-K-style differentiates through the final K K steps, with K K selected on validation ( Clark et al. 2024 ) . KL-PG uses at most a capacity-matched scalar value baseline and excludes DIAL’s action-conditioned Q-Critic and KL-natural solver ( Black et al. 2024 ; Fan et al. 2023 ) . Detailed information, compute, and output-distortion ledgers appear in the supplement.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: DIAL adapts ensemble stochasticity during generation rather than calibrating completed forecasts. It converts signed reliability gaps across scales into future costs and adjusts native noise through KL-natural updates within a Path-KL budget. On frozen FCN3, DIAL improves multiscale skill and pooled reliability over learned postprocessing and reward-based control at the registered budget, although not every metric improves. Its local control is limited to the Actuator’s noise coordinates and requires a Pilot forecast and multi-member scoring. DIAL therefore provides an auditable reliability-aware stochastic closure without retraining the forecaster.

For fixed ξ \xi , the ideal law specifies a full-path skill-and-moment tilt
relative to the native process. It does not prescribe a terminal marginal and
is therefore not a classical fixed-endpoint bridge ( Léonard 2014 ) . Proposition A.1 alone does
not establish a saddle-point interchange, an optimal multiplier, or projection
onto the zero-moment reliability set. The reachable family can also be
nonconvex, so the practical controller is a receding local approximation to the
fixed-dual Gibbs objective, not an exact global reliability projection.
For precision, despite the main paper’s compact “I-projection toward
reliability” shorthand, P ξ , h ∗ P_{\xi,h}^{*} is not literally asserted to be a KL
projection onto a reliability set. The formal result is only the fixed- ξ \xi Gibbs identity above: it does not assert that P ξ , h ∗ P_{\xi,h}^{*} belongs to the
zero-moment reliability set or solves the original constrained problem.

blocks.en:
The full evaluated coordinate set gives the best primary score, RMSE gain, and
pooled reliability ratio at comparable realized KL. Amplitude-only control
retains 97.9% of full DIAL’s small-scale skill but 77.5% of its large-scale
skill, consistent with amplitude repair being more complete at smaller scales.
Persistence-only control retains substantial long-lead skill while giving
lower small-scale and aggregate skill. Coupling intensity and persistence
within each source recovers complementary scale and lead benefits: the
source-tied restriction improves nMS-afCRPS, large-scale skill, and long-lead
skill over either single-coordinate restriction, with the full evaluated
source-matched coordinate set retaining the strongest overall performance.
